name: topics:subscribe (D-102, retired 2026-08-09)
description: Surface config for the topics:subscribe retirement (coordination-spec-adoption-2026-08-03 D-102). The retired thing is the TOOL DOOR only — the base primitive watch:create { targetKind:'topic', wake:false } keeps every cell, and the whole subscription substrate (subscribeTopic, coord_entity_subscriptions, the full/digest/mention modes) stays live. That is exactly why a bare-word scan is useless here: 'subscribe' matches the substrate this retirement deliberately preserved, plus a dozen unrelated live surfaces (topics:unsubscribe, work_items:subscribe, state:subscribe, conversations:join, the SSE notify path). Identifier-anchored matching on the exact tool name is the only scan that separates the door from the room.
